description:
Get a download link for a model the caller owns (authenticated). The returned
    download_url is a TOKEN link valid for 24 hours; fetching it redirects to a
    storage URL minted fresh per request with a much shorter life (~30 min), so the
    redirect target expires long before the download_url does.
    vpuid/level are optional: the server resolves them from site_no (build records also
    carry them first-class).
name: download_model
title: Get a model download link
